\operatorname{StrictAltRun}_{D,E}(\tau)
\Longleftrightarrow
\exists n\in\mathbb N_{>0}\,
\exists a\in\mathsf{Act}_{\mathsf{Lud}}^{n-1}\,
\Bigl[
\tau=((\rho_0,\sigma_0),\ldots,(\rho_{n-1},\sigma_{n-1}))
\wedge
\forall i+1<n\
(\rho_{i+1}=\rho_i a_i\wedge
\sigma_{i+1}=\sigma_i\overline{a_i})
\wedge
\forall i+1<n\,(a_i=\operatorname{daimon}\Rightarrow i+2=n)
\wedge
\forall i+2<n\
\bigl(\operatorname{pol}(a_i)\ne0\wedge
\operatorname{pol}(a_{i+1})\ne0
\Rightarrow
\operatorname{pol}(a_i)\ne\operatorname{pol}(a_{i+1})\bigr)
\Bigr].
